annotations.title: Israeli Self-Employed Pension & Training-Fund Tax Benefits

description: Calculate the tax benefits for a self-employed person's deposits to a pension fund and to a self-employed training fund, under the Income Tax Ordinance: the training-fund deduction (s.17(5א), deduction only — no credit), the pension deduction (s.47(ב)(1), 7% plus up to 4% on the part paid above 12%), the 35% pension credit (s.45א(ב),(ד)) and the extra self-employed credit (s.45א(ו)), with their ceilings. Scope: all chargeable income is business income, under 50 at the start of the year, no disability-insurance deduction, the regular (non amit-mutav) track. Salary or other income, age 50+, and a disability-insurance deduction are refused. Not computed and named in notIncluded: the amit-mutav track, life and survivors' insurance, spouse payments, the 2024 reservist re-allocation (s.53א), tax on early training-fund withdrawals, the mandatory pension-deposit duty and the tax itself. Approved tax years: 2024, 2025, 2026. Not tax advice.

age_50_or_over_at_year_start.description: true if the person was 50 or older at the start of the tax year. Enhanced deduction rates apply (regulations under s.47(ד)) and are not computed, so true is refused.

annual_income.description: Annual taxable income from business or profession (הכנסה חייבת מעסק או ממשלח יד), in NIS — after business expenses, BEFORE the training-fund, pension and National Insurance (s.47א) deductions

claimed_disability_insurance_deduction.description: true if a deduction is claimed for disability-insurance premiums (ביטוח מפני אבדן כושר עבודה, s.32(14)). It reduces eligible income and cancels the s.45א(ו) extra credit, and is not computed, so true is refused.

has_other_taxable_income.description: true if the person had any other chargeable income in the tax year besides the business income above and besides salary — e.g. rent, interest or dividends, capital gains. Pension eligible income (s.47(א)(1)) is measured on ALL chargeable income, so true is refused.

has_salary_income.description: true if the person also had salary/employment income (הכנסת עבודה) in the tax year. This tool covers business income only; true is refused, because the ceilings and rates differ (ss.47(א)(1)(3), 45א(ד)(2)(ב)(2), and the combined training-fund ceiling).

pension_contribution.description: Amount the self-employed person actually paid in the tax year to a pension fund (קופת גמל לקצבה) as an independent member, in NIS

tax_year.description: Tax year of the deposits. Approved tax years: 2024, 2025, 2026. Any other year is refused.

training_fund_contribution.description: Amount actually paid in the tax year to a self-employed training fund (קרן השתלמות לעצמאים), in NIS
